row.team_price_text: Routing & Scheduling: from $1,250/mo ($15,000/yr), 15 seats included, $45/seat/mo after
row.evidence: Chili Piper's help centre documents SAML 2.0 SSO with any IdP but says "JIT provisioning is not supported"; its only provisioning automation takes Salesforce as the source, and no SCIM endpoint appears in the help centre, the Edge API spec or the Okta app.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM: SAML SSO (Routing & Scheduling and up) with no JIT; the Okta OIN app is SAML only (read from the page markup: only SAML is checked). The pricing page's 'User provisioning' line refers, as far as the help centre shows, to Salesforce-sourced provisioning automations (Users > Provisioning, 'the only source is Salesforce'); the CRM sync also removes inactive users periodically. Pricing is flat platform pricing billed annually: Routing & Scheduling from $1,250/mo (15 seats, $45/seat/mo extra), Experiences from $3,500/mo (30 seats, $50/seat/mo extra), ChiliCal standalone $12/user/mo with a 200-seat minimum, Chili Data Platform 'coming soon'. The Edge API (on all plans) can invite users, read/find users, update profiles, assign or revoke licences and manage workspace/team membership, but has no documented endpoint to remove a user from the org.

auth.notes: Tenant API key sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <api-key>' (or ?apiKey= for GET). Tokens are created in Integrations > API Access Tokens with per-section permissions (Ping, Modify, Read, Remove).

endpoints.purpose: Invite (create) a new user in the organization
Send invitation emails to existing users
Bulk assign or revoke product licenses
Read all users (or in a workspace)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks cover meeting lifecycle events only (MeetingCreated, MeetingUpdated, MeetingDeleted).

limitations.text: No documented endpoint removes or deactivates a user in the org; the API removes users from workspaces/teams and revokes licences only.
Roles can be set only at invite time per the spec (roles on user-invite); role changes are otherwise made in the Command Center.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks only SAML as checked (SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate unchecked).

fallbacks.other_sync: Salesforce-sourced provisioning automations (add/revoke licences, workspaces, teams, distributions) and CRM sync that periodically removes inactive users
